offering_description.value: Provides online and campus-based degree and certificate programs for working adults, mainly undergraduate and graduate programs in business, nursing, technology and education. It delivers instruction largely online, with support services, and earns tuition from students.

primary_services.value: online degree programs; campus degree programs; certificate programs; career advising; employer education partnerships

customer_segment.value: B2C: working adults and career changers enrolling in degree and certificate programs; B2B: employers sponsoring employee tuition and training programs

end_markets.value: higher education; workforce development; healthcare education; IT training

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees paid by students for degree and certificate programs; other: federal student aid and employer tuition assistance that pays student tuition

value_chain_position.value: service provider: provides accredited instruction and student services, sold to adult students and employers; software / platform: operates online learning platform used to deliver courses to students

geography_served.value: US national: students enrolled across all US states, with campuses and learning centers in multiple states

specialization.value: related lines: business, nursing and healthcare, technology, and education degree programs sharing students and admissions channels

distribution_channels.value: online: online courses delivered to students nationwide; own locations: campuses and learning centers in multiple US states; direct sales: admissions advisors recruiting students and employer partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: accredited institution participating in federal student aid, overseen by the US Department of Education and regional accreditors

notes: Based on general knowledge of the company's education business; current program mix, campus footprint and ownership details may have changed.
